p: book: Because they would be assured and their posterity confirmed in the hope of this deliverance promised.

voice of trembling: He shows that before this deliverance will come, the Chaldeans would be extremely afflicted by their enemies, and that they would be in such perplexity and sorrow as a woman in her travail as Isa 13:8.
day is great: Meaning that the time of their captivity would be grievous.
For it shall come to pass: When I will visit Babylon.
his yoke from off thy neck: Of the king of Babylon.
bring him into subjection: That is, of Jacob.

David their king: That is, Messiah who would come of the stock of David according to the flesh and would be the true pastor, Eze 34:23 who is set forth and his kingdom would be everlasting in the person of David, Ho 3:5.

leave thee altogether unpunished: In this is commanded God's great mercy toward his, who does not destroy them for their sins, but corrects and chastises them till he has purged and pardoned them and so burns the rods by which he punished them, Isa 33:1.
palace shall remain after its manner: Meaning that the city and the temple would be restored to their former estate.
thanksgiving and the voice of them: He shows how the people will with praise and thanksgiving acknowledge this blessing.
nobles shall be from themselves: Meaning, Zerubbabel, who was the figure of Christ in whom this was accomplished.
heart to approach to me: Signifying that Christ willingly submits himself to the obedience of God his father.
the whirlwind of the LORD goeth: Lest the wicked hypocrites should flatter themselves with these promises the prophet shows what will be their portion.
latter days ye shall consider it: When this Messiah and deliverer is sent.
